_doc: RoboPaint caoshu (草书 臨帖) targets. singles: [slug, character, structure (single | left-right | top-bottom | enclosure)] (difficulty extreme); works: [slug, characters, frame_mm] (difficulty extreme; no repeated character; the column as written: the characters share ONE frame, a centred square of frame_mm, so the ligatures between them stay on the sheet). Each task's exemplar is its own graphics.txt-format file (--graphics <slug>.graphics.txt: one JSON line per character, "strokes" = the regions of its ink, Make Me a Hanzi em coordinates), made by scripts/robopaint_caoshu/cs_exemplar.py from a public-domain scan (spec: scripts/robopaint_caoshu/exemplars.json); the contact limit is --max-strokes = the exemplar's connected contacts (cs_exemplar.py), one plan per contact (--plans, cs_plan.py). sources: the README's SOURCES text per slug ("*" = the default); licence: the exemplar record written into the graders' truth and target.png's PNG comment (licences[slug] overrides it); notices: the NOTICE-exemplar.md texts (agent's / graders' copies). Every text is checked by ci_checks/check-robopaint-leak.sh like every README sentence.

sources.*: Wikimedia Commons, File:張旭 古詩四帖.jpg (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E5%BC%B5%E6%97%AD_%E5%8F%A4%E8%A9%A9%E5%9B%9B%E5%B8%96.jpg): 張旭《古詩四帖》 (attributed to Zhang Xu, Tang, 8th century, cursive script, ink on coloured paper, Liaoning Provincial Museum; the text is two poems of Yu Xin's 步虛詞 and two eulogies by Xie Lingyun). Licence on the file page: {{PD-old-70}} (public domain; a faithful reproduction of a two-dimensional work more than 1200 years old). The characters were cropped from this scan (downloaded unmodified on 2026-10-08, 11787 x 1600 px, SHA-1 b2e19768317f8234c3308a91013934240bf1074f), binarised and placed on the sheet; a work keeps its column as written.
